entries.evidence: Geometry only, to be checked in the booklet before it is signed (the steps that build trunk.ldr and fit it to the car). The trunk (trunk.ldr, 35 parts) is attached to nothing: its two pins 2780 (p744, p745) sit on the axes of the 64782's holes (p757), 0.00 off, ending at the holes' faces. Moved 20 LDU down and 20 back (y +20, z -20) it makes 50 joins with the rest, as placed 0; 67 with x moved 5 or 10 either way, along the pins, so x is left as built.
